attributes.title: AAPA 2027
attributes.summary:
AAPA 2027 takes place May 21 to 25, 2027, at the Phoenix Convention Center in downtown Phoenix. AAPA describes 200+ hours of CME across 45 therapeutic categories, hands-on workshops, Main Stage sessions, an expo and the PA JobSource Career Fair, and expects more than 5,000 PAs and PA students.

Registration and hotels opened October 28, 2026. With an AAPA hotel-block stay, full registration for PA members starts at $600 (super saver, through November 11, 2026), then $700 early bird through January 13, 2027; nonmembers start at $1,000. Staying outside the block costs up to $200 more. NPs and affiliates register in a separate category; the free retired-member registration does not include CME.
